title: Auth and notification string extraction
summary: Auth screens, emails, notifications, flash messages, and validation attribute labels now come from UK English lang files. Password-reset copy stays non-enumerating, and accounts prefer en_GB for queued mail.
changes: Move Public Login, Register, Staff Login, forgot/reset password, verify-email, and landing copy into lang/en_GB/auth.php.
Move shared flashes and auth abort messages into lang/en_GB/flash.php and auth.oidc.* keys.
Move pending first-login chase and Cases/Tickets/Consultations update emails into lang/en_GB/mail.php.
Keep password-reset status non-enumerating via passwords.request_status; expand validation.attributes for common form fields.
Implement HasLocalePreference on User so notifications render in en_GB (users.locale column arrives in a later Language wave).
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.38.x Language line: auth/mail/flash extraction only — Admin, public chrome, and staff hub extracts follow in later patches.
validation: PHPUnit LocalisationAuthExtractionTest (HasLocalePreference, auth copy, password-reset status, mail keys).
Ticket/case/consultation workflow suites covering notification mail paths.
php artisan lang:inventory — Auth section count 0; docs/i18n-inventory.md regenerated.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Admin shell, public chrome (legal/dashboard/recruitment board), and APES CIC staff hub strings remain hard-coded until subsequent Wave 2 patches.
users.locale column and SetLocale middleware are not in this release (#275).
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. UI returns to prior hard-coded English strings if lang keys are removed; no database migrations are included.
